findings.finding: The published title/catalog says EMA and MAMA, while the executable source trades MAMA/FAMA crosses and does not compute a separate EMA.
findings.decision: Freeze MAMA/FAMA as the root. Do not invent an EMA condition.

findings.finding: The public source reverses through strategy.entry and has no explicit exit, same-day liquidation or Bid/Ask model.
findings.decision: Reject public PnL and execution. Separate signal identity from QROS management and execution profiles.

findings.finding: atan(q1/i1) and atan(im/re) have zero-denominator and quadrant ambiguity; degree/radian interpretation is not explicitly bound by the source artifact.
findings.decision: Preserve a literal-source interpreter branch and create a separately tagged quadrant-aware Ehlers descendant. No silent substitution.

findings.finding: Recursive p, MAMA and FAMA state depends on implicit nz initialization and lacks a convergence/warm-up eligibility contract.
findings.decision: Freeze exact zero bootstrap, per-configuration convergence warm-up and gap-reset/carry semantics.

findings.finding: The public strategy can execute on the signal close.
findings.decision: Signal is known only after the completed bar; execution begins at the first eligible quote strictly later than that close.

findings.finding: Floating-point recurrence, equality at a cross and rolling quantiles can diverge across implementations unless serialized and computed explicitly.
findings.decision: Freeze integer-scaled parameters, IEEE-754 binary64 rules, strict cross ties and nearest-rank prior-only quantiles; require exact signal-mask parity.
